methodologyNotes: Six vendor pricing pages fetched directly via WebFetch on 2026-06-15/16. QuickBooks Live (quickbooks.intuit.com/live/) returned HTTP timeout on every attempt (JS-heavy SPA) and all known alternate Intuit pricing URLs either 404'd or timed out; QuickBooks Live is excluded rather than guessed. Pilot Core plan shows '$0/month billed annually' for pre-revenue startups only; for revenue-generating companies the price requires contacting sales, so Core is recorded as null. Botkeeper is priced per accounting-firm license (one license = one client entity), so billingModel is per_seat. Bench annual prices confirmed as $1,910/$3,830/$5,750/year with 20% discount versus $199/$399/$599 month-to-month. All minutesIncluded/callsIncluded/overagePerMin/overagePerCall fields are null (non-telephony vertical). hipaa/baa/bilingual set to null unless explicitly stated on vendor pages.
